description: This file defines the 'VoidHandler' interface for handling void actions on 'Voidable' objects within the OpenMRS API. It specifies a contract for implementing classes to set void attributes such as voided status, reason, user, and date.

classes.name: VoidHandler
classes.description: A generic interface for handling void operations on objects implementing 'Voidable'. It extends 'RequiredDataHandler' and enforces implementation of the 'handle' method to set void attributes on the target object.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Sets all void-related attributes on the 'Voidable' object, including voided status, reason, user, and date. This method must be implemented by classes implementing 'VoidHandler'.
